findings.text: When stack has fewer than 2 newlines, stackWithoutTwoTopLines becomes empty string, causing endsWith('') to always return true and incorrectly skip appending the stack. Example input: stack='at func1\nat func2' (one newline) results in secondNewlineIndex=-1, stackWithoutTwoTopLines='', and the condition !err.stack.endsWith('') is false, so valid stack traces are silently dropped.
